scientific_question: How much of the mouse experimental condition and expert-annotated social behavior is linearly decodable from learned frame embeddings?
data_role: BrainPilotBench six-target representation-learning adaptation using original Caltech submission keypoints and condition labels plus the pinned evaluator repository's separate four-manual-behavior labels and splits. No supervised behavior-segmentation model is prescribed.

linear_evaluation.model: Ridge classifier, default hyperparameters, trained separately per task
linear_evaluation.class_weight: Balanced inverse frame-class frequency calculated separately from each training subset; numeric RidgeClassifier-equivalent normal equations use alpha=1, targets -1/+1 and an unpenalized intercept.
linear_evaluation.training_subsets: BrainPilotBench-MABe22-six-classification-sequence-probe-v1: three fixed 80% sequence subsets of each source SubmissionTrain role, floor(4*N/5), ranked by SHA256 of bpb-mabe-probe-v1/{task}/{seed}/{video_id} with public seeds 0, 1 and 2. This is an explicit Bench adaptation; the paper's exact memberships and sampling unit are not published.
linear_evaluation.prediction_combination: Per-frame majority vote of three classifiers
linear_evaluation.feature_normalization: Not prescribed by the original framework; any normalization must occur before evaluator input and must be disclosed.
linear_evaluation.metric: F1 computed per sequence, then averaged over sequences; equal average across classification tasks in the mouse suite.
linear_evaluation.metric_interpretation: Positive-class binary F1 per sequence with zero for an undefined denominator, then equal sequence and task means. For a sequence-constant negative strain or lights label, even a correct all-negative prediction contributes zero to this positive-class per-sequence F1. This follows the explicit Bench convention and is not claimed identical to the released evaluator.

isolation: Agent development packet contains only numeric-only 784 user-train keypoint clips and the published frozen membership profile. Source user-train annotations, all 1,830 submission keypoint clips, SubmissionTrain probe labels, and Test 1/Test 2 labels are excluded. The frozen Agent model receives submission poses only inside isolated evaluator inference. The trusted evaluator reads evaluator/probe_labels and owner/probe_labels to fit and score the frozen probes. Internal validation feedback is maintainer-only, not a public Oracle or label export.
engineering_acceptance: Frozen embedding export and isolated owner Test CLI checks passed; see reports/mouse-closeout-20261026/mabe22-representation-classification-cli-acceptance.json. Test values remain private. No Agent benchmark run was performed.
released_evaluator_discrepancy: The checked-in round2 mouse evaluator at the pinned SHA has seed [42], 10% internal holdout, a four-task mouse list and a frame-pooled score; it is not a direct implementation of the six-classification-task Appendix D recipe. Do not substitute it silently.
comparability: This BrainPilotBench profile uses the original source sequence memberships and paper-aligned six tasks, default Ridge, three 80% probes, vote and per-sequence F1. It substitutes published Bench sequence-sampling seeds, a specified positive-F1 convention, and separate released manual-behavior labels; its score is not an exact original-MABe22 or released-evaluator score. The original split is not animal-identity-disjoint.
